{{Disambig|Frost}}

==Towers==
'''Frost''' may refer to these event towers:
*[[Frost Blaster]], an offensive and support [[Towers|tower]] that can freeze enemies
**[[Frost Blaster/Gallery]]
**[[Frost Blaster/History]]

==Enemies==
'''Frost''' may refer to these enemies:
*[[Frost Acolyte]], a summoner enemy that first appears on Wave 19 in [[Frost Mode|Frost]] mode
**[[Frost Acolyte/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Frost Hero]], a high health enemy that first appears on Wave 35 in [[Frost Mode|Frost]] mode, and on Wave 21 on Easy difficulty and Wave 35 on Hard difficulty in [[Outpost 32 (Operation I.C.E)]]
**[[Frost Hero/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Frost Hunter]], a high health enemy that first appears on Wave 15 in [[Frost Mode|Frost]] mode, and on Wave 14 on Easy difficulty and Wave 18 on Hard difficulty in [[Outpost 32 (Operation I.C.E)]]
**[[Frost Hunter/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Frost Invader]], a high health enemy that first appears on Wave 24 in [[Frost Mode|Frost]] mode, and on Wave 20 on Easy difficulty and Wave 26 on Hard difficulty in [[Outpost 32 (Operation I.C.E)]]
**[[Frost Invader/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Frost Mage]], a high health flying enemy that first appears on Wave 32 in [[Frost Mode|Frost]] mode, and on Wave 22 on Easy difficulty and Wave 28 on Hard difficulty in [[Outpost 32 (Operation I.C.E)]]
**[[Frost Mage/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Frostmite]], an enemy spawned by the [[Permafrost]], that first appears on Wave 10 in [[Frost Mode|Frost]] mode
**[[Frostmite/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Frost Mystery]], an enemy that spawns random enemies upon death, that first appears on Wave 9 in [[Frost Mode|Frost]] mode, and on Wave 18 on Easy difficulty and Wave 23 on Hard difficulty in [[Outpost 32 (Operation I.C.E)]]
**[[Frost Mystery/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Frost Necromancer]], a high health summoner enemy that first appears on Wave 35 in [[Frost Mode|Frost]] mode, and on Wave 24 on Easy difficulty and Wave 32 on Hard difficulty in [[Outpost 32 (Operation I.C.E)]]
**[[Frost Necromancer/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Frost Ravager]], a fast, high health enemy that first appears on Wave 28 in [[Frost Mode|Frost]] mode, and on Wave 23 on Easy difficulty and Wave 30 on Hard difficulty in [[Outpost 32 (Operation I.C.E)]]
**[[Frost Ravager/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Frost Spirit]], a major boss that first appears on Wave 40 in [[Frost Mode|Frost]] mode, and on Wave 25 on Easy difficulty and Wave 40 on Hard difficulty in [[Outpost 32 (Operation I.C.E)]]
*[[Frost Undead]], a fast, high health enemy that first appears on Wave 23 in [[Frost Mode|Frost]] mode
**[[Frost Undead/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Frost Wraith]], a hidden enemy that first appears on Wave 18 in [[Frost Mode|Frost]] mode
**[[Frost Wraith/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Mega Frost Mystery]], an enemy that spawns random enemies upon death, that first appears on Wave 25 in [[Frost Mode|Frost]] mode
**[[Mega Frost Mystery/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Permafrost]], an enemy that spawns [[Frostmite]]s on death, that first appears on Wave 14 in [[Frost Mode|Frost]] mode
**[[Permafrost/Advanced Stats]]

It can also refer to these removed enemies:
*[[Frost Hero (Pre-MEGA)]], a high health enemy that could stun towers, that appeared on Wave 66 prior to the [[Pre-MEGA Modes/Waves|MEGA Update]]
*[[Frost Hero (Village of Despair)]], a high health enemy that could stun towers, that appeared in the [[Hidden Wave (Legacy)|Legacy Hidden Wave]] and on Wave 14 in [[Village of Despair]]

It can also refer to these event enemies:
*[[Frost Hero (Frost Invasion)]], a high health enemy that could stun towers, that appeared in the [[Hidden Wave (Legacy)|Legacy Hidden Wave]] and Wave 19 in [[Outpost 32 (Frost Invasion)]]
*[[Frost Invader (Frost Invasion)]], a fast, high health enemy that first appeared on Wave 14 in [[Outpost 32 (Frost Invasion)]]
*[[Frost Mystery (Frost Invasion)]], an enemy that spawned a random enemy upon death, that first appeared on Wave 8 in [[Outpost 32 (Frost Invasion)|Outpost 32]]
*[[Frost Necromancer (Frost Invasion)]], a high health summoner enemy that can summon 4 [[Snow Minion (Frost Invasion)|Snow Minions (Frost Invasion)]], that first appeared on Wave 19 in [[Outpost 32 (Frost Invasion)]]
*[[Frost Ravager (Frost Invasion)]], a slow, high health enemy that first appeared on Wave 16 in [[Outpost 32 (Frost Invasion)]]
*[[Frost Spirit (Frost Invasion)]], a major boss that first appeared on Wave 20 in [[Outpost 32 (Frost Invasion)]]
*[[Frost Tank]], a high health enemy that threw boulders at towers, that first appeared on Wave 13 in [[Village of Despair]]
*[[Siege Engine]], internally named '''Frost Spawner''', an enemy that appeared in [[Outpost 32 (Operation I.C.E)]]

==Maps==
'''Frost''' may refer to these maps:
*[[Krampus Frosthold]], a map during the [[Krampus' Revenge Event]].
